scope: Offline accounting for three explicitly submitted human excerpt answers; retain original context predictions, parser disagreements and original scores
remaining_priority: Recompute original point aggregation after removing only explicitly confirmed question-scoped warning codes; retain all other cases, passages, scientific blockers and audit membership
disagreement_or_uncertainty: Retain unresolved flags and require adjudication; no invented decision or probability
agreement_denominator: Displayed fact questions compared with frozen source-context interpretations, not baseline-parser accuracy, population accuracy or full-source QA
next_review_wave: Prepare up to three short checks from still-open original first-wave priority packets; show exact source context and no predictions or expected answers
owner_feedback_scope: Human excerpt checks of development-exposed material; not independent full-filing gold
